jp-20260825-news-3.title: Inbound tourism spending in Japan hits record high of 2.5096 trillion yen for April-June, with the US overtaking China as top market

segments.src: ## 訪日外国人旅行消費額が四半期ベースで最高を更新
segments.tr: ## Inbound foreign tourist spending hits record high on quarterly basis

segments.src: 観光庁が公表した統計によると、2026年4〜6月期における訪日外国人旅行者の消費額は2兆5096億円となり、前年同期比0.2%増を記録した。これは同時期としては過去最高の水準であり、訪日観光市場が引き続き拡大基調にあることを示す結果となった。
segments.tr: According to statistics released by the Japan Tourism Agency, spending by foreign visitors to Japan in the April-June 2026 quarter reached 2.5096 trillion yen, a 0.2% increase compared to the same period last year. This is the highest level on record for this period, showing that the inbound tourism market continues to be on an expansionary trend.

segments.src: 伸び率自体はわずかにとどまったものの、水準としては過去最高を更新した点が注目される。訪日客数の増減や為替動向、消費単価の変化などが複合的に影響したとみられ、観光関連産業にとっては引き続き重要な指標となっている。
segments.tr: Although the growth rate itself remained slight, attention is drawn to the fact that the level updated the record high. It is believed that a complex combination of factors such as fluctuations in the number of visitors, exchange rate trends, and changes in spending per capita had an impact, making it an important indicator for tourism-related industries.

segments.src: ## 国籍別では米国が首位に浮上
segments.tr: ## US rises to top spot by nationality

segments.src: 今回の統計で特に目を引くのが、国・地域別の消費額ランキングで米国が首位に立ったことだ。これまで訪日消費をけん引してきた中国を上回り、米国が最大の消費市場となった点は、訪日インバウンド市場の構造変化を象徴する動きといえる。
segments.tr: Particularly striking in this statistic is that the United States took the top spot in the spending ranking by country and region. Surpassing China, which has driven inbound spending until now, the US becoming the largest consumer market can be said to symbolize a structural change in the inbound tourism market.

segments.src: 一般的に、米国からの訪日旅行者は滞在日数や一人当たりの消費単価が比較的高い傾向があるとされ、円安基調が続く為替環境も購買力を後押しした可能性がある。一方で中国からの訪日動向については、渡航需要の回復ペースや消費行動の変化など、複数の要因が影響しているとみられ、単純な比較だけでは背景を語り尽くせない面もある。
segments.tr: Generally, visitors from the US tend to have relatively long stays and higher spending per capita, and the exchange rate environment with the continuing weak yen may have also boosted purchasing power. On the other hand, regarding inbound trends from China, multiple factors such as the pace of recovery in travel demand and changes in consumer behavior are thought to be at play, and simple comparisons cannot fully explain the background.

segments.src: ## 消費構造の変化が示す意味
segments.tr: ## What the changes in the consumption structure signify

segments.src: 国籍別トップの入れ替わりは、単なる順位の変動にとどまらず、訪日観光市場全体の消費構造が変わりつつあることを示唆している。特定の国・地域に依存しない、多様な市場からの需要獲得が、今後の観光関連産業にとって重要なテーマになりそうだ。
segments.tr: The shift at the top by nationality is not merely a change in ranking, but suggests that the consumption structure of the entire inbound tourism market is changing. Acquiring demand from diverse markets without depending on specific countries or regions is likely to become an important theme for the tourism-related industry moving forward.

segments.src: 宿泊、飲食、小売など幅広い業種が訪日消費の恩恵を受けており、消費額が過去最高を更新したことは、地域経済や雇用にも一定のプラス影響を与えていると考えられる。今後、政府や自治体、観光関連事業者がどのような施策で市場ごとの特性に対応していくかが注目される。
segments.tr: A wide range of industries such as lodging, dining, and retail are benefiting from inbound spending, and the record high spending is considered to have a certain positive impact on regional economies and employment. Moving forward, attention will focus on what kind of measures the government, local municipalities, and tourism-related businesses will use to respond to the characteristics of each market.

segments.src: 訪日外国人旅行消費額は、為替動向や国際情勢、各国の景気動向など複数の要因に左右される。今回の統計で示された米国の躍進が一時的なものか、今後も続く傾向なのかは、次期以降のデータを踏まえて見極める必要がある。
segments.tr: Inbound foreign tourist spending is influenced by multiple factors such as exchange rate trends, international conditions, and economic trends in each country. Whether the surge of the US shown in this statistic is temporary or a continuing trend needs to be determined based on data from the next period onward.

segments.src: 観光庁は今後も四半期ごとに統計を公表する方針で、次回以降の発表でも消費額や国籍別の動向に注目が集まりそうだ。訪日観光を巡っては、インフラ整備やオーバーツーリズム対策なども並行して議論されており、消費額の伸びと持続可能な観光地経営の両立が今後の課題となる。
segments.tr: The Japan Tourism Agency plans to continue releasing statistics on a quarterly basis, and attention is likely to focus on spending amounts and trends by nationality in future announcements as well. Regarding inbound tourism, infrastructure development and overtourism countermeasures are also being discussed in parallel, making the balancing of spending growth and sustainable destination management a future challenge.
